name: fill_quad_bounds
describe: Unpacks a BakedQuad's int[28] vertexData (4 verts x 7 ints), takes min/max XYZ of the 4 vertex positions into the 12-float quadBounds array, and computes the 2 boundsFlags bits per face. PURE: IBlockState.isFullCube() reduced to a boolean input; EnumFacing reduced to a local enum with the same D-U-N-S-W-E indices.
